title: All the Tribes at Shechem
text: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem.

title: Before God
text: … and they presented themselves before God.

title: One from Every Tribe
text: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem.

title: Long Ago
text: Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.

title: I Took Your Father Abraham
text: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants.

title: Isaac, Jacob and Esau
text: I gave him Isaac, and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau.

title: Moses and Aaron
text: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.

title: Your Fathers Cried Out
text: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians …

title: You Crossed the Jordan
text: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho.

title: A Land You Did Not Toil For
text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build …

title: Beyond the Euphrates
text: … lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.

title: Fear the LORD and Serve Him
text: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth …

title: Cast Aside the Gods
text: … cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

title: Choose This Day
text: … then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve …

title: As for Me and My House
text: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!

title: Far Be It from Us
text: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!

title: A Holy God
text: You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God …

title: You Are Not Able
text: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD …

title: We Will Serve the LORD
text: No! | We will serve the LORD!

title: You Are Witnesses
text: You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.

title: Get Rid of the Foreign Gods
text: get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.

title: Incline Your Hearts
text: … and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.

title: Obey His Voice
text: We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.

title: A Covenant
text: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people …

title: A Statute and Ordinance
text: … and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance.

title: A Large Stone
text: Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD.

title: A Witness against Us
text: You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us …

title: Each to His Own Inheritance
text: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

title: Joshua Died at 110
text: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.

title: Buried at Timnath-serah
text: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim …

title: Israel Served the LORD
text: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him …

title: The Bones of Joseph
text: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem …

title: To Whom Would We Go?
text: Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

title: All the Elders and Leaders
text: He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel …

title: Judges and Officers
text: He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel …

title: My House
text: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!

title: Vineyards You Did Not Plant
text: … and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.

title: Sincerity and Truth
text: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth …

title: A Stone That Has Heard
text: It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us …
